research_findings: Identified that 'react-hooks/refs' ESLint errors were caused by accessing a React ref (preferReducedMotion.current) during render in AdaptiveCoachDemo.
Discovered several unused ESLint disable directives for 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' and 'react-hooks/refs' across multiple files due to updated ESLint config or resolved hooks.
Found test output pollution in several test files due to expected errors and warnings.
features_improved: AdaptiveCoachDemo landing component: Changed preferReducedMotion from a useRef to a useState to correctly trigger React re-renders when accessibility preferences change, fixing hook access violations.
Code quality: Cleaned up unused and obsolete ESLint disable directives across the codebase to adhere to strict linting rules.
Test Output: Silenced expected console.warn and console.error output in ProblemIntrosPanel, StepByStepChat, TimerWidget, etc to clean up test suites.
next_steps_for_next_run: Review application-wide test suite to systematically identify and silence all expected but noisy console.error and console.warn calls.
Explore optimizing the session-storage.ts parsing mechanism.
